    kt.bulan_num AS bulan,
    km.kpi_name AS nama_kpi,
    kt.realisasi AS realisasi,
    km.target AS target_kpi,
    km.achieve AS achieve_kpi,
    km.partial AS partial_kpi,
    km.fail AS fail_kpi,
    kt.keterangan AS keterangan
FROM 
    kpi_tracker_records kt
JOIN 
    kpi_master_records km ON kt.kpi_master_id = km.id
JOIN 
    users u ON u.id = kt.user_id
WHERE 
    kt.bulan_num = (SELECT MAX(bulan_num) FROM kpi_tracker_records)
LIMIT 1000;
